integrity: The universal upper bound and construction are proved symbolically. Exhaustive computation is used only as an independent finite cross-check of the channel model and formula, not as a substitute for the proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to exactly one reverse-complement duplication of length \(2\) over an even alphabet with a fixed-point-free complement involution. It does not classify all maximizers or address other duplication lengths. A September 2026 preprint on multiple reverse-complement and palindromic duplications was available only at abstract level during the comparison and remains a stated originality risk.
title: Exact worst-case inverse degree for length-two reverse-complement duplication
